name: slack-mcp
description: Adds korotovsky/slack-mcp-server for reading channels, message history, threads, and user groups with a Slack bot token. A bot sees only the channels it was invited to. Only read tools are enabled, so posting, reactions, and user-group changes stay off. From 2026.10.25 it replaces the archived reference Slack server: Ave asks for the xoxb- bot token again and passes it as SLACK_MCP_XOXB_TOKEN; SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, SLACK_TEAM_ID and SLACK_CHANNEL_IDS are no longer read.
